summary: C-7 is met. createApp(store) in src/server.mjs rewrites the count paragraph to '<store.length> notes' for GET /; tests cover 0 and 3 notes (npm test: 9 pass, 0 fail). In the browser the running dev server at localhost:4173 shows '0 notes' under the Lantern Notes heading. The diff stays inside the slice paths (src/server.mjs, tests/server.test.mjs); public/ is untouched; no secrets, English only, no weakened tests. One major caveat, agreeing with the critic: the standalone entry point serves createApp([]), so the live page can only ever show 0 because nothing in the app populates a store yet. N equals the store length, so the criterion holds as written.

findings.issue: The standalone entry point uses a fresh empty array, so the running page cannot show a non-zero count; a non-zero count is verified only through tests that call createApp with a populated store.
findings.suggestion: Wire a shared store into the entry point, or record the limitation in the handoff.

criteria.note: Page at / shows '0 notes' for the empty store; tests show '3 notes' for three notes.

browser.note: Started npm start, viewed / in own tab, closed tab and stopped the server afterwards.
